name: DISA Limited
summary: DISA Limited, an investment holding company, operates as a technology enterprise across Singapore, China, Hong Kong, and the United States. Its core business is providing advanced asset protection solutions for the retail sector. Key offerings include the Point-of-Sale Activation (POSA) Smart Lock, which digitally deactivates consumer electronics until purchase; a unique single-scan serialization smart barcode to prevent return fraud; FreshCounts for detailed item tracking; and the DiSa Smart Shelf and DiSa Smart Case, designed to deter in-store theft. It also offers Product ID Live, a smart tool for overall loss prevention and eliminating return fraud. These solutions are implemented on consumer products in retail stores, safeguarding retailers and their suppliers from theft and fraudulent activities. Beyond these, DISA also provides digital security, anti-theft, and anti-counterfeiting solutions, complemented by marketing and technical support services. Furthermore, the company is involved in research and development, the sale of semiconductor devices, and the manufacturing and distribution of healthcare instruments. Established in Singapore in 1975, the entity initially operated as Equation Summit Limited before rebranding to DISA Limited in February 2017.
